- Extraction misses things; dirty data can be archived / deleted on the chip strip or edited"},{"id":"p36s3","text":" / merged in Settings.
- Do not open the same `.tdb` from two Node processes at once (one `dsh web` "},{"id":"p36s4","text":"is enough). The panel now says so instead of showing the raw TDB error.
- **Supported window width: "},{"id":"p36s5","text":"900 px and up.** At 390 px the host keeps a fixed 188 px settings sidebar, leaving ~154 px for the p"},{"id":"p36s6","text":"lugin column (~106 px cards); the layout collapses but is not readable. Phone-width support is inten"},{"id":"p36s7","text":"tionally not claimed.
- Markdown export is for humans; it cannot be parsed back. Git-friendly write-"},{"id":"p36s8","text":"back is `trivium.jsonl`, not Markdown. External import (WorkBuddy / Claude Code / Codex) is one-shot"},{"id":"p36s9","text":", not two-way sync, and does not ingest session jsonl dumps.
- Do not merge `.tdb` in git (binary). "},{"id":"p36s10","text":"Track `trivium.jsonl`; ignore `.tdb`. jsonl merge conflicts are ordinary text — resolve, then reopen"},{"id":"p36s11","text":" the workspace.
- The session layer (when on) projects compaction and fork; it does not split boxes "},{"id":"p36s12","text":"by message count. If the window has not reached DSH’s compact line, **Update checkpoints** will not "},{"id":"p36s13","text":"invent history boxes — use **Create checkpoint**.
- Plugin setting toggles (chips / session layer / "},{"id":"p36s14","text":"git sidecar / recall / extract) save immediately. Embedding fields use Save; if a saved change does "},{"id":"p36s15","text":"not take effect, restart `dsh web`.
- **0.5.0 writes JSONL `v: 2` and graph JSON `version: 2`.** Bot"},{"id":"p36s16","text":"h are additive and a v1 file still reads, but downgrading is not supported in place: an older build "},{"id":"p36s17","text":"ignores the revision relations and will drop them on its next write. To go back, restore the pre-upg"},{"id":"p36s18","text":"rade file group (`.dsh/trivium.tdb` plus `.dsh/trivium.jsonl`) rather than letting the old build rew"},{"id":"p36s19","text":"rite it.
- A decision chain is linear in this release: one predecessor, one successor. Splitting one"},{"id":"p36s20","text":" version into several, or a fan-in, is refused instead of half-applied.
- Deleting a replacement rel"},{"id":"p36s21","text":"ation from the JSONL file is reported as a conflict, not applied. Revoke it in the panel.
